correctness.rationale: Fourteen rational geometric projective-line components and twenty-one ordinary nodal gluings give a stable genus-eight curve. Three distinct markings ensure a genuine GL_3(F_2) action and Galois descent in every characteristic. Normalization identifies Pic^0 character lattice with H_1 of the incidence graph, not just with a rationalized representation. A standard-library exact verifier exhausts the 168 invertible binary matrices, checks the complete conjugacy and orbit classification, and establishes the four unimodular integral normal-form identities (determinants +1,-1,-1,+1). The first-field point counts and complete zeta formula follow from nodal normalization; all q>=2 cases are covered. The attached verifier was executed and yielded VERIFY_OK. The correctness limit is the scope of the stated full proof, not a claim of external certification.

value.rationale: The point-line Fano incidence graph is a canonical trivalent, genus-eight dual graph rather than an arbitrary parameter slice. Its associated stable curve is a natural boundary object in curve degeneration theory. Computing all its arithmetic Picard tori, not just orders or isogeny classes, distinguishes induced tori from a genuine cubic norm-one factor; the classification determines exact rational abelian groups for every finite field and all complete curve zeta spectra. The sharp order-seven point-free criterion is a concrete geometric consequence. These evaluated integral answers are neither a small numerical improvement nor automatic from the graph-curve definition, though the general normalization machinery is classical.
